# ADR 0006: custom branch naming

**Status:** accepted

**Context.** `gh issue develop` links a branch to the issue's Development sidebar, but it names branches from the issue title and cannot produce the `<login>/<type>/` prefix without `--name`, which would make it add nothing.

**Decision.** Branches are `<login>/<type>/<issue>-<kebab>`, generated by `cw branch-name` (at most 5 words, 60 characters, ASCII only). `Closes #N` in the PR provides the equivalent link at the PR level.

**Follow-up.** `gh issue develop --name <scheme>` remains an optional enhancement to evaluate later.
